text:
Olivia CSM: Hey team — Luminary Health is asking for a temporary regional exemption for their JP pilot. They hit a throttle during the ingest demo this morning and asked for a short QPS bump + outbound proxy allowlist to Tokyo edge. Details below.

Olivia CSM: TL;DR: need +150 QPS for 72h, allowlist 3 egress IPs, and route to ap-northeast-1 region. Customer is in trial, pilot demo tomorrow, renewal talk next month; high impact if we don't unblock.

Jin (netops): Can you paste the IPs and exact time window? Also do they require NAT or direct peering?

Olivia CSM: IPs: 203.0.113.21, 203.0.113.22, 203.0.113.23. Window: 2024-11-05T02:00Z -> 2024-11-08T02:00Z (72h). They want outbound through our JP edge (ap-northeast-1) — no private peering, just public egress.

Kai (infra): We can do a temporary QPS override with a must-match tag on their account. Need account id and confirmation they accept auto-revoke after 72h. Who's the account?

Olivia CSM: Account: luminary-health-prod (acct_id: LH-9182). They've signed TOS for pilot. Confirm auto-revoke OK.

Sam (prod-ops): I can add a rate-window override and a model routing rule to prefer ap-northeast-1 for their requests. Plan: set QPS +150, attach a route tag route_region=ap-northeast-1, add egress allowlist for the three IPs. I'll deploy canary then full.

Priya (compliance): Quick check — any extra data residency notes? Are they sending PHI in demo? If yes, we need documented consent for egress through JP edge.

Olivia CSM: They're sending pseudonymized clinical notes for demo only. Customer confirmed no raw PHI. They've provided a signed demo data statement (attached to Zendesk 4521).

Jin (netops): I will add the three IPs to the JP edge firewall allowlist and create a temporary NAT mapping. Command I'll run:```netops-cli add-allow --region ap-northeast-1 --ips 203.0.113.21,203.0.113.22,203.0.113.23 --expires 2024-11-08T02:00Z```

Sam (prod-ops): Kicking off canary now (10% traffic) with the route override. Watchlist: increased 429s, latency spikes, and KV cache misses.

oncall-bot: Canary deploy started for LH-9182 (canary id c-7791). Rollout monitor: https://console.redwood/inflight/c-7791 (alerts will post here).

Kai (infra): Canary looks stable so far (10m). QPS at +80, no error uptick. I'll schedule the full bump in 15m if stable.

Sam (prod-ops): Full bump applied. QPS +150 active and egress allowlist in place. Route tag applied.

Jin (netops): Firewall entries added and verified from our JP node. NAT mapping healthy.

Priya (compliance): Reviewed demo data statement; logging requirement noted. Please ensure audit log flag is ON for LH-9182 for the period.

Sam (prod-ops): Audit logging ON for that account during the window. We'll rotate logs to secure bucket with retention 90 days.

Olivia CSM: Amazing — thank you! I'll confirm with Luminary and remind them auto-revoke is scheduled for 2024-11-08T02:00Z. If they need extension, we can do a follow-up.

Kai (infra): Noted. If they request extension, we need 24h lead and a business case.

Olivia CSM: Will do. Closing the loop after the demo. :raised_hands:
